definition: to force a rule, tax or opinion on people
sentence: The city {imposed} a fee for driving in the centre.
translation: Город ввёл плату за въезд в центр.

definition: a feeling of worry or fear about what might happen
sentence: I get a lot of {anxiety} before job interviews.
translation: Перед собеседованиями я сильно нервничаю.

definition: to improve the quality or value of something
sentence: A good sauce can really {enhance} a simple meal.
translation: Хороший соус может здорово улучшить простое блюдо.

definition: to be the strongest or most important in a situation
sentence: Their team {dominated} the whole second half of the match.
translation: Их команда полностью владела игрой весь второй тайм.

definition: so stupid that people can only laugh at it
sentence: The rent they ask for that tiny room is {ridiculous}.
translation: Аренда, которую они просят за эту каморку, просто смешная.

definition: a published list, or one item in a list such as a house for sale
sentence: The {listing} for the flat says it has two bedrooms and a balcony.
translation: В объявлении о квартире сказано, что в ней две спальни и балкон.

definition: to keep something going at the same level over time
sentence: I can't {sustain} this pace of work for much longer.
translation: Я не смогу долго держать такой темп работы.

definition: to change how you act so you fit a new situation
sentence: It took me a month to {adapt} to the night shifts.
translation: Мне понадобился месяц, чтобы привыкнуть к ночным сменам.

definition: to fall down suddenly because of weakness or no support
sentence: The old shelf {collapsed} under the weight of the books.
translation: Старая полка рухнула под тяжестью книг.

definition: to take money out of a bank account
sentence: I need to {withdraw} some cash before the trip.
translation: Мне нужно снять немного наличных перед поездкой.

definition: to produce a result, crop or profit
sentence: The small garden {yields} enough tomatoes for the whole summer.
translation: Маленький огород даёт достаточно помидоров на всё лето.

definition: to give a good reason why something is right
sentence: How can you {justify} spending that much on shoes?
translation: Как ты можешь оправдать такие траты на обувь?

definition: to officially stop something for a short time
sentence: The club {suspended} him for two games.
translation: Клуб отстранил его на две игры.

definition: to finish something difficult with success
sentence: We {accomplished} more in one week than they did all month.
translation: Мы за неделю сделали больше, чем они за месяц.

definition: to notice or find something that is hard to see
sentence: The app {detected} a problem with my phone's battery.
translation: Приложение обнаружило проблему с батареей телефона.

definition: to accept a new idea or change with enthusiasm
sentence: The whole team {embraced} the idea of working from home.
translation: Вся команда с радостью приняла идею работать из дома.

definition: to see or understand the difference between two things
sentence: I can't {distinguish} the twins when they wear the same clothes.
translation: Я не могу различить близнецов, когда они одеты одинаково.

definition: the health, comfort and happiness of a person or group
sentence: The school really cares about the {welfare} of its students.
translation: Школа действительно заботится о благополучии учеников.

definition: a new business or activity that involves risk
sentence: Their coffee {venture} failed after six months.
translation: Их кофейный бизнес прогорел через полгода.

definition: to refuse to consider an idea because it seems unimportant
sentence: Don't {dismiss} the plan before you hear the details.
translation: Не отметай план, пока не услышишь подробности.

definition: to change something slightly to make it better or different
sentence: We {modified} the recipe to use less butter.
translation: Мы немного изменили рецепт, чтобы было меньше масла.

definition: to limit how much someone can do, have or use
sentence: The doctor {restricted} my coffee to one cup a day.
translation: Врач ограничил меня одной чашкой кофе в день.

definition: not often, almost never
sentence: I {rarely} eat meat these days.
translation: В последнее время я редко ем мясо.

definition: to get something, like pleasure or an idea, from a source
sentence: I {derive} a lot of pleasure from cooking for friends.
translation: Мне очень приятно готовить для друзей.

definition: to tell someone that something is true so they stop worrying
sentence: He {assured} me the package would arrive by Friday.
translation: Он заверил меня, что посылка придёт к пятнице.

definition: the possibility that something will happen in the future
sentence: The {prospect} of another winter here scares me.
translation: Перспектива ещё одной зимы здесь меня пугает.

definition: to judge how good, big or important something is
sentence: The doctor needs to {assess} the damage before we talk about surgery.
translation: Врачу нужно оценить повреждение, прежде чем говорить об операции.

definition: the amount by which one thing is bigger or better than another
sentence: We won by a {margin} of two points.
translation: Мы выиграли с разницей в два очка.

definition: to begin dealing with a difficult problem
sentence: Let's {tackle} the kitchen first and then the bedroom.
translation: Давай сначала разберёмся с кухней, а потом со спальней.

definition: the ability to make yourself do what you should
sentence: It takes {discipline} to study every evening after work.
translation: Нужна дисциплина, чтобы заниматься каждый вечер после работы.

definition: to stop yourself from doing something you want
sentence: I couldn't {resist} buying one more pair of boots.
translation: Я не удержалась и купила ещё одну пару сапог.

definition: to deal with and win against a problem or fear
sentence: She {overcame} her fear of flying last summer.
translation: Прошлым летом она преодолела страх полётов.

definition: a position in a list that shows how good someone is compared with others
sentence: She rose to third in the world {ranking} after the final.
translation: После финала она поднялась на третье место в мировом рейтинге.

definition: sometimes, but not often
sentence: We {occasionally} go to the cinema on Sundays.
translation: Иногда по воскресеньям мы ходим в кино.

definition: to keep someone or something out of a group or activity
sentence: Why did they {exclude} me from the meeting?
translation: Почему меня не позвали на встречу?

definition: something that a person leaves behind after they die or leave
sentence: Her {legacy} at the school is the big library.
translation: Её наследие в школе — большая библиотека.

definition: pressure caused by too much work, worry or weight
sentence: The long hours put a lot of {strain} on our marriage.
translation: Долгие рабочие часы сильно давили на наш брак.

definition: something that stops people from doing or getting something
sentence: Language was the biggest {barrier} when we moved here.
translation: Язык был главным препятствием, когда мы сюда переехали.

definition: an agreement where each side gives up part of what it wants
sentence: We reached a {compromise}: pizza tonight, salad tomorrow.
translation: Мы пришли к компромиссу: сегодня пицца, завтра салат.

definition: a very large amount of money
sentence: That jacket must have cost a {fortune}.
translation: Эта куртка, наверное, стоила целое состояние.

definition: more and more over time
sentence: It's {increasingly} difficult to find a flat here.
translation: Найти квартиру здесь становится всё труднее.

definition: to ask a person or a book for advice or information
sentence: You should {consult} a lawyer before you sign anything.
translation: Прежде чем что-то подписывать, посоветуйся с юристом.

definition: to officially leave your job
sentence: He {resigned} after a fight with his boss.
translation: Он уволился после ссоры с начальником.

definition: acting like a wise adult, not like a child
sentence: She's very {mature} for a fifteen-year-old.
translation: Она очень взрослая для своих пятнадцати лет.

definition: real and exactly what it seems to be, not fake
sentence: Is this bag {genuine} leather or plastic?
translation: Эта сумка из настоящей кожи или из пластика?

definition: only, nothing more than
sentence: I was {merely} asking, you don't have to shout.
translation: Я просто спросил, не надо кричать.

definition: an unfair opinion that makes you treat someone or something differently
sentence: He has a clear {bias} against anyone younger than him.
translation: У него явное предубеждение против всех, кто моложе его.

definition: to judge the value or quality of something carefully
sentence: We'll {evaluate} the results after the first month.
translation: Результаты мы оценим после первого месяца.

definition: the buildings, traditions and culture passed down from the past
sentence: The old town is part of the city's {heritage}.
translation: Старый город — часть наследия этого города.

definition: about, more or less, not exactly
sentence: The trip takes {roughly} two hours by car.
translation: Поездка занимает примерно два часа на машине.

definition: a clear and deep understanding of a complicated thing
sentence: Her book gave me a real {insight} into how banks work.
translation: Её книга дала мне настоящее понимание того, как работают банки.

definition: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted
sentence: Pull every {weed} out of the flower bed before you plant the seeds.
translation: Вырви все сорняки с клумбы, прежде чем сажать семена.

definition: a small piece of advice or information given in an indirect way
sentence: Give me a {hint}: is the present bigger than a book?
translation: Подскажи немного: подарок больше книги?

definition: to control an activity with rules
sentence: This device {regulates} the temperature in the room.
translation: Этот прибор регулирует температуру в комнате.
